title: Wall Mount towel bar 24-Inch Solid Brass Mambo Collection, straight bar, concealed mount Allied Brass
description:
Add refined storage with a wall mount towel bar crafted from solid brass, built for 24-inch center-to-center installation. It’s part of the mambo collection for matching mambo coordination with other designer bath accessories and designer bathroom hardware.

Highlights:
- Solid brass towel rack / towel bar construction
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean wall-mounted look
- Wall mount design helps save floor space
- Includes towel bar, mounting plates, and installation hardware
- Available in a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes (statement bath accessories colors include Venetian Bronze, Antique Pewter, Lavender, Glokzin Teal, and Unlacquered Brass)

Specs:
- Type: Towel Bars; Shape: straight bar; Mounting type: Wall mount
- Center-to-center: 24 in; Diameter: 0.5 in
- Overall: 25 in W x 3 in H; Projection: 3 in
- Weight capacity: 10 lb; Product weight: 2.4 lb
- Assembly required: False
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
